explanation: A stray delete command began wiping the film's files from Pixar's servers. Much of the work was rescued from a copy that technical director Galyn Susman kept on her home computer.

claims.text: During production of Toy Story 2 (1999), a command run on Pixar's servers accidentally deleted most of the film's files.
The deletion was caused by a delete command run by mistake on Pixar's file servers.
Much of the deleted work was restored from a copy kept on technical director Galyn Susman's home computer.
